correctness.rationale: The proof is exhaustive. The four transverse intersection points form a projective frame, so every stabilizer element is among 24 uniquely determined frame permutations. Exact rational pullback checks give four elements fixing \(C_1\) and \(C_2\), none swapping them, and only the identity also fixing \(C_3\). The combinatorial tangency pattern forces any arrangement equivalence to preserve \(C_3\) and the pair \({C_1,C_2}\); therefore the four distinct lines give four distinct \(\operatorname{PGL}_3\)-orbits and each arrangement has trivial stabilizer.

value.rationale: The source's main geometry is a two-component realization space. Determining that its four canonical displayed representatives are nevertheless four separate projective orbits is a natural moduli refinement, and the triviality of each projective automorphism group identifies the lack of hidden symmetry behind those representatives. This is more than a normalization or recomputation of the published splitting type.
